title: Agreement on a fixed coordinate
statement: Let $\rho,\eta:\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\{\mathrm{free},\mathrm{fix\ one},\mathrm{fix\ negative\ one}\}$, where $n$ is a natural number. If $\eta$ extends $\rho$ in the sense that it agrees with $\rho$ at every coordinate where $\rho$ is not free, then $\eta(i)=\rho(i)$ for every coordinate $i$ at which $\rho(i)$ is not free.
